claim: Streaming structured data lets the interface become interactive while the model is still producing the result.
Raw token streaming exposes broken JSON, while semantic parsing can expose a valid partial object.
Fields such as numbers should be withheld until complete because intermediate token prefixes can be misleading.
Schema annotations control whether a partial field is optional or withheld until its value is done.
The demo renders structured streamed steps into UI components as each usable part arrives.
Model generated layouts are possible, but the speakers note that rendering quality still depends on application design.
